description: This file contains utility functions for file path operations within the Mattermost server, including searching for files/directories, resolving paths, and checking directory conflicts.

methods.name: CommonBaseSearchPaths
methods.description: Returns a list of common base search paths including the current directory, parent directories, and the package path of the server.

methods.name: findPath
methods.description: Internal function that searches for a given path within specified base search paths, considering whether to prioritize the working directory.

methods.name: FindPath
methods.description: Public wrapper around findPath with workingDirFirst set to true.

methods.name: FindFile
methods.description: Searches for a file in ancestor directories and the executable's directory.

methods.name: FindDir
methods.description: Searches for a directory in ancestor directories and the executable's directory, defaults to './' if not found.

methods.name: FindDirRelBinary
methods.description: Searches for a directory relative to the executable's directory, then the working directory, defaults to './' if not found.

methods.name: CheckDirectoryConflict
methods.description: Checks if two directories are subdirectories of each other or the same, resolving symlinks and absolute paths.
